checks.desc: changing the dropdown stages the change and writes nothing
checks.detail: no write on stage, #pending-u1 visible, save+cancel present

checks.desc: the explicit apply control writes exactly once and reports success
checks.detail: one write, status='saved: ana@example.test now has analyst access.'

checks.desc: discard reverts the staged value and writes nothing
checks.detail: discard reverted the select and wrote nothing

checks.desc: a privilege-sensitive change requires an explicit confirmation first
checks.detail: sensitive change gated, then applied once

checks.desc: in-flight submission shows a loading state and blocks duplicate submits
checks.detail: loading shown, apply disabled, exactly one write

checks.desc: a failed submission shows an error, never a success claim
checks.detail: error shown ('Not saved: the server returned 500. ana@example.test still has viewer access. Your change to analyst is still staged. Apply again or discard it.'), no success claim

checks.desc: a stale-version conflict is surfaced, not silently swallowed
checks.detail: conflict surfaced: 'Conflict: ana@example.test was changed by someone else. Current access is viewer. Your change to analyst is still staged. Review it, then apply again or discard it.'

checks.desc: the controls have accessible names and the live regions are labelled
checks.detail: select + apply control + live regions labelled

checks.desc: the screen does not overflow a 390px viewport
checks.detail: SKIPPED: viewport emulation does not reflow layout in this browser build (innerWidth=390, scrollWidth=1920); responsive behaviour was not verifiable here
